summary: No repository record I could open holds 3D segmented plant parenchyma. Two plant datasets exist with raw cell-wall volumes (Arabidopsis embryos, ~100 stacks, 3.18 GB tar) or segmentations and lineages (shoot apical meristem, 6 NPA-treated plants, 4.89 GB zip), but both are young growing tissue, not bulk parenchyma, and neither is documented to carry face counts. The BioImage Archive has no plant 'parenchyma' study.
next_step: Download one of the two Arabidopsis sets (both over 1 MB, not fetched here), check what segmentation labels exist for the meristem set, and decide whether interior meristem cells are an acceptable stand-in; otherwise scout a segmented mature-tissue volume (e.g. pith or storage parenchyma).
obstacles_confirmed: Few datasets resolve complete cell faces over large parenchyma volumes.
Meristem and embryo cells are a young, growing subset of the symmetrical parenchyma the claim is about.
